groups.sentence: Students accused of AI misuse have the opportunity to respond to the allegation and present their explanation or evidence.
Students may appeal an AI misuse decision through the university's appeal process.
Students receive fair, transparent treatment and due process in AI misuse cases.
Students accused of AI misuse may contest the allegation or defend themselves, including through a meeting with the instructor.
Instructors notify the student and offer the available resolution options after suspecting AI misuse.
Students can seek support from campus staff, such as Community Standards or the Disability Access Center, when handling an allegation.
Students must submit their written statement within the set deadline after an allegation.
Reports of suspected AI misuse go to the department chair, who gathers information.
